technician_view.do_not: No generated adjustment values, bypass steps, reset instructions or inferred authorization to operate.
technician_view.escalation: Escalate recurrent symptoms, conflicting findings or uncertain safe operating condition to the maintenance lead and operations owner; use the site safe-state procedure.
technician_view.headline: Repeated feeder symptoms; root cause not confirmed
technician_view.next_safe_action: Review the current approved procedure and record the observed symptom, job/part revision, stop reference and what was checked. Only qualified personnel may perform work under site authorization.

temporal_rule: Filter source records, claims, inspection, comparable periods, verification, recurrence and joined relationships by selected scenario as_of and known_at/available_from. Effective guidance additionally requires an effective applicability interval. Future plans may be shown as plans, never observed outcomes.

verification.before_after_claim: 600 to 300 jam minutes across ten eligible shifts each; runtime 3900 to 4200 minutes. Observed association, not isolated causal proof.
verification.effectiveness: Post outcome improves; guardrail and sustain gates remain distinct.
verification.intervention_scope: DEMO-WO-003 is simulated approved like-for-like guide replacement restoring existing design; not EC-003 implementation.
verification.release_state: EC-003 is not released; proposed SW-030 FIC-E remains blocked.
verification.repair_completion: Recorded action and return to service only.
